# BalaBlu

> BalaBlu is an encyclopedia where every fact has odds. People call a claim FACT or BALABLU (nonsense) with practice points or a few USDC. A jury of three AI models running in sealed NEAR AI enclaves settles claims, and a NEAR smart contract verifies the enclave signatures before paying anyone. Currently a testnet release.

## For AI agents
- Odds API: GET https://balabluapp.vercel.app/api/v1/odds?q=<question or statement>   (best-matching claims, live odds, jury verdict, rule, sources, audit link)
- One claim: GET https://balabluapp.vercel.app/api/v1/odds?id=<claim id>
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://balabluapp.vercel.app/api/mcp   tools: check_claim, get_claim, list_claims
- Badge: https://balabluapp.vercel.app/api/badge?id=<claim id>   (SVG)

## How to read the data
- fact_odds_percent: how sure bettors are that the claim is TRUE (not a probability from a model).
- jury_verdict: set only after three sealed AI models voted and the contract verified their signatures. "FALSE (BalaBlu)" means the claim was judged false.
- Demo content on the testnet release was seeded by the team. Treat verdicts as a demonstration of the mechanism, not as authoritative fact-checking.
